Contract-§3 data for the same two slugs as mobile-demos.generated.json, so the props table, the announced-strings list and the enum list can all be built and graded before scripts/build-mobile-api.mjs lands. Deliberately covers both branches: LumoIconButton has a required String, LumoCheckbox has none.

LumoButton.doc: The primary action — the web button's contract on Material's button: four variants, three sizes on the shared control scale, disabled announced, pressed takes the "hover" fill, focus ring for keyboard and switch access.

props.name: child
props.description: The button's content. A raw number in a Text is the app's problem — Dart cannot forbid it by type, formatNumber is the rule.

props.name: onPressed
props.description: Null makes the button inert and announces it as disabled.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disabled state, announced as well as painted.

LumoIconButton.doc: A button that is only an icon. Its name is a required parameter: there is no content for a screen reader to fall back to.

props.name: label
props.description: The announced name. Required: an icon announces nothing on its own.

props.name: icon
props.description: The glyph. Decoration — the label is the name.

props.name: onPressed
props.description: Null makes the button inert and announces it as disabled.

LumoCheckbox.doc: A checkbox with its label, description and error message wired into one semantics node, so the box is announced with everything that qualifies it.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, which is also the announced name.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: The announced name when there is no visible label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label, announced with the box.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shown and announced when isInvalid is true.

props.name: isSelected
props.description: Controlled state. Leave null and pass defaultSelected for an uncontrolled box.

props.name: isIndeterminate
props.description: The mixed state a parent box shows when only some children are selected.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disabled state, announced as well as painted.
